title: HomeGuard Rating Factors for Midterm Changes and Renewal Increases
content:
Rating worksheet factors of the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy: the smallest prorated midterm premium change that is billed or credited, the annual rate for a change in Coverage A, the annual price of each step along the liability ladder, and the automatic Coverage A increase applied at renewal.

## Factors by package

| Factor | HO-3 Essential | HO-3 Enhanced | HO-3 Premier | HO-5 Enhanced | HO-5 Premier | HO-5 Signature |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum prorated premium change billed or credited (USD) | 10.00 | 10.00 | 5.00 | 10.00 | 5.00 | 0.00 |
| Annual premium per 1000 of midterm Coverage A change (USD) | 4.86 | 4.62 | 4.41 | 5.08 | 4.79 | 4.35 |
| Annual premium per step up the liability limit ladder (USD) | 21.00 | 19.00 | 17.00 | 19.00 | 26.00 | 24.00 |
| Inflation guard: automatic Coverage A increase at each renewal (percent) | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 5 | 6 |

Column headings shorten HomeGuard HO-3 Essential, HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced, HomeGuard HO-3 Premier, HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced, HomeGuard HO-5 Premier and HomeGuard HO-5 Signature.

## Factor definitions

- **Minimum premium change.** A midterm endorsement premium change whose prorated amount is below this figure is neither billed nor credited. On HomeGuard HO-5 Signature the figure is 0.00, so no prorated change falls below it.
- **Coverage A rate.** The annual premium charged for each 1000 USD by which Coverage A is changed midterm.
- **Liability step premium.** The annual premium for each step up the package's ladder of liability limits.
- **Inflation guard.** The percentage by which Coverage A is increased automatically at each renewal.

## Worksheet lines (hypothetical inputs)

| Hypothetical input | Package | Worked figure |
|---|---|---|
| Coverage A raised midterm by 20000 | HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | 20 thousands at 4.62 each: 92.40 annual |
| Coverage A raised midterm by 50000 | HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | 50 thousands at 5.08 each: 254.00 annual |
| One step up the liability ladder | HomeGuard HO-5 Premier | 26.00 annual |
| Prorated change of 7.50 | HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | 7.50 is not below 5.00: billed or credited |
| Prorated change of 7.50 | HomeGuard HO-3 Essential | 7.50 is below 10.00: neither billed nor credited |
| Expiring Coverage A of 300000 | HomeGuard HO-5 Signature | inflation guard of 6 percent: an increase of 18000 |
